key_insight: EHRNote-ChatQA is a new benchmark for multi-turn clinical question answering that tests both answer quality and evidence grounding across longitudinal discharge summaries.
clinical_relevance: It better reflects how clinicians review multiple discharge notes over time, making it useful for evaluating LLMs in realistic hospital-document workflows.
method: Built from de-identified MIMIC-IV discharge summaries spanning 1 to 5 notes per patient
Uses expert-curated multi-turn QA templates plus LLM-generated questions, then reviewed and revised by 11 medical experts
Pairs 8,036 content questions with matching evidence-grounding questions across 8 clinical categories
evidence_signal: The benchmark includes 967 patient-level samples and 16,072 expert-verified QA pairs, and testing 22 LLMs showed evidence grounding is harder than content answering.
watch_item: Because the task depends on longitudinal note context and verified evidence, strong benchmark performance may not directly translate to safe real-world clinical use without careful validation.
paper_title: EHRNote-ChatQA: A Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Multi-Turn Clinical Question Answering over Longitudinal Discharge Summaries
